detail.longDescription: OpenAI's 62% one-month jump in researchers' coding agent spend (median $2,400/day in October) has a footnote: an Aug 21 harness efficiency change coincided with a sharp drop in input tokens that "appears to have severely depressed" recorded spend. Rollback began Sept 10. If you trend agent cost, log the harness version next to the model. A harness change alone can bend the curve. https:// openai.com/index/research-acce leration-jagged-frontier/ # AI # AIAgents # Observability
